title: Gameplay chest level mapping
level_semantics: Sequential gameplay levels using the selected Atelier source materials in their approved ranking order
level_policy: Retained Atelier models are renumbered sequentially. After the last available material, every level through 99 reuses that material without changing its authored finish.
path_scope: Model, image, image-part and sprite-manifest paths are relative to the tesisgame project root. Authoring-model paths are relative to the chest review collection.

levels.name: Wayfarer Oak
levels.ranking_reason: Layered oak framing, fitted hinges and a shaped lock enrich the plain survival case.

levels.name: Ironbound Trail
levels.ranking_reason: Reinforced hoop joints, layered metal plates and finished wood deepen the platformer chest.

levels.name: Duskwatch Coffer
levels.ranking_reason: Fitted plate layers, reinforced joints and a layered lock enrich the mini-dungeon construction.

levels.name: Dungeon Keeper
levels.ranking_reason: Studded iron armor, fitted hinges and a deeper lock assembly enrich the compact dungeon chest.

levels.name: Cooper Star
levels.ranking_reason: Shaped wooden staves, fitted silver hoops and a raised compass lock give the barrel a crafted reward silhouette.

levels.name: Tideguard
levels.ranking_reason: Colored metal rails, fitted handles and an inset star create a decorated maritime case.

levels.name: Meadow Cabinet
levels.ranking_reason: Layered painted rails, fitted handles and shaped locking hardware add cabinetry detail.

levels.name: Sunward
levels.ranking_reason: Warm gold rails and fine scored finishing enrich the honey-colored shell.

levels.name: Harvest Strongbox
levels.ranking_reason: Relief panels, reinforced straps and articulated chain fittings enrich the carved harvest case.

levels.name: Gilded Waywatch
levels.ranking_reason: Brushed iron hoops, gilded corner shoes and an ornate pierced clasp elevate the finished oak case.

levels.name: Verdant Oath
levels.ranking_reason: An emerald hero setting and layered green shield distinguish the reinforced timber reliquary.

levels.name: Bonbon Keepsake
levels.ranking_reason: Layered pearl-pink bands, fitted clasp hardware and polished edge details enrich the keepsake case.

levels.name: Velvet Parcel
levels.ranking_reason: A sculpted satin bow, fitted red wrapping bands and gilded medallions give the lacquered gift its ceremonial silhouette.

levels.name: Moonbound
levels.ranking_reason: Silver fittings, purple enamel and crystal accents introduce an arcane finish.

levels.name: Royal Rose
levels.ranking_reason: Gilded trim, ruby fittings and a crowned inner lid create a royal presentation.

levels.name: Lagoon Reliquary
levels.ranking_reason: Layered pearl-blue armor, fitted wing ornaments and detailed locking hardware enrich the maritime silhouette.

levels.name: Moonstone Crown
levels.ranking_reason: A refined lifting crown, layered silver framing and faceted insets elaborate the floating-cover vault.

levels.name: Prism Signal
levels.ranking_reason: Layered corner armor and a luminous triangular seal give the wide case a strong focal point.

levels.name: Aegis Transit
levels.ranking_reason: Fitted white armor, a protected carry handle and inset cyan shield form a detailed advanced transport case.

levels.name: Frost Relay
levels.ranking_reason: Icy ceramic armor and a nested reactor core create an energized advanced case.

levels.name: Solar Relay
levels.ranking_reason: Dense gold armor, recessed vents and a layered reactor introduce a heavier ceremonial finish.

levels.name: Nova Buddy
levels.ranking_reason: A protected signal canopy, expressive face and heart medallion make a special companion reward.

levels.name: Jade Reliquary
levels.ranking_reason: Gilded cage fittings and a large faceted emerald emphasize precious gem armor.

levels.name: Crimson Citadel
levels.ranking_reason: Crimson enamel, gold guards and a layered ruby crest form an ornate fortified case.

levels.name: Regent Wings
levels.ranking_reason: Swept layered gold wings, a large ruby and fitted golden bands create a regal reward centerpiece.

levels.name: Cobalt Vault
levels.ranking_reason: Obsidian panels, silver corner cages and a dominant cyan jewel create an arcane vault.

levels.name: Rune Sentinel
levels.ranking_reason: Engraved luminous glyphs, layered dark-silver armor and a deep circular lock give the arcane case a dense crafted finish.

levels.name: Aether Vault
levels.ranking_reason: Ivory ceramic, gold cages and a large amethyst seal give the vault a ceremonial finish.
